question.text: Molar mass of the hydrocarbon (X) which on ozonolysis consumes one mole of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></math> per mole of (X) and gives one mole each of ethanal and propanone is ______ g mol<sup>–1</sup> (Molar mass of C : 12 g mol<sup>–1</sup> , H : 1 g mol<sup>–1</sup> )

solution.text: When 2-methyl butene-2 is subjected to ozonolysis and then reduced in presence of dimethyl sulphide or Zn dust, it yields acetone and acetaldehyde. Cycloaddition of a molecule of ozone occurs first and then it is cleaved reductively to give aldehyde and ketone.
